newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia seizes 52,000 jars of fake Vaseline.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia seizes 52,000 jars of fake Vaseline.

text.p: Saudi Arabia seized 52,000 jars of fake Vaseline in a Commerce Department sting operation, the daily Arab News reported Sunday.
"The large quantity of imitation Vaseline ... was seized from a warehouse after it was put under surveillance and then inspected by a special task force," the paper said.
Vaseline is made by Anglo-Dutch congolemerate Unilever Plc.

The Arab News said the jars were manufactured in an unnamed Arab country, adding that the law firm representing the Unilever agent in the kingdom said the company did not produce the seized lubricant.
The English-language newspaper said Unilever lodged several complaints last year against local dealers selling imitation products.
